latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Quickly publish local Markdown/HTML as shareable online links.

- Supports Markdown and HTML input files.
- Generates temporary online links (1–7 day expiry options).
- No registration required; uses dpaste.com API.
- Simple command-line usage and mobile-friendly access.
- Ideal for speeches, meeting notes, presentations, or temporary document sharing.
